serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Nun.Face.nunFaceNormal
'Nun' Shanice: Come on now, what’s up with that look? It's like you are seeing a ghost! If you are going to keep staring like that, you will hurt my feelings! 
You: But you…
'Nun' Shanice: Died? Yeah, I guess. 
You: I’m sorry…
'Nun' Shanice: For what? It’s not like it’s your fault. 
'Nun' Shanice: Don’t get me wrong, you could’ve done things differently, but there was no way for you to know that it would end up like that. Life is like that: unfair. 
You: Then why are you here? 
#Nun.Face.nunFaceHappy
'Nun' Shanice: What, you want me gone already? 
#Nun.Face.nunFaceNormal
You: Of course not! It’s just…
'Nun' Shanice: Don’t worry, I’m just teasing you a little!
You: …
'Nun' Shanice: The reason I’m here…{{wi}} You should know better than anyone, right? No person should witness what you did. 
#Nun.Eyes.HappyClosed+Nun.Mouth.Normal
You: But what am I supposed to do?! What should I think?! Sometimes, when I close my eyes, I…
#Nun.Face.nunFaceNormal
'Nun' Shanice: You don’t need to do anything. I’m just here to tell you that it wasn’t your fault. 
You: But shouldn’t I have done more?! Go to the police... or…
'Nun' Shanice: Maybe you should, and maybe you would’ve ended up like me and Priestcan.
#Nun.Eyes.HappyClosed+Nun.Mouth.Angry
You: Even if you say that, it’s all in my head. Everything you say isn’t real. It’s just me coping… 
#Nun.Face.nunFaceNormal
'Nun' Shanice: Well, it’s not like I can totally deny it, but let me do one thing for you. I want you to stop losing sleep over that old memory. 
You: And how am I supposed to do that? It will torment me for the rest of my life!
'Nun' Shanice: Don’t worry, I will call in for a favor or two!
You: What is that even supposed to mean? You are making no sense!
You: And what about the duel? Isn’t that how it works?
#Nun.Face.nunFaceHappy
'Nun' Shanice: Yeah, I don’t know shit about fishing, so I will pass!
#Nun.Face.nunFaceNormal
You: …
'Nun' Shanice: Don’t worry about us, everything’s fine. I promise.
'Nun' Shanice: Oh, one more thing, I will have to make you forget about all of this. 
You: I can’t remember what’s taking place here anyway. 
#Nun.Face.nunFaceHappy
'Nun' Shanice: Let’s just say that this time it will be in a more permanent way.
